H1_IDENTITY.content_note: identity requires ty6 strictly between ty4 and exact; held at every configuration including the three where the band FAILS

H5.why: band/|ty4-exact| = 1/ratio = 2(1-r) identically, so H5's assertion 2(1-r)<2.5 is equivalent to r>-0.25 and cannot fire for r>=0. Empty firing world. Descends from the same identity as H1: two hypotheses, one determination.

H6_BOOKKEEPING.note: the only 'ratio' keys in that file are ||P||_G/gap ratios, unrelated to the band statistic

EXTENSION_remedy.note: q exceeds 1 from delta_b=0.40 while the band still holds through 0.55; geometric model q/(1-q) mispredicts r by 0.77x-152x and goes negative. q<1/3 was never false-safe over 12 configurations at ONE site - sufficient-looking, far from necessary, do not generalise.
